bullets.text: A deaf boy in Tiruttani was hit by a train while going out to relieve himself because his government-built home lacked a toilet, and the office should inspect sanitation facilities.
Auto drivers held a sudden protest in Pethikuppam near Uthukottai and Gummidipoondi demanding the cancellation of free bus travel, and the office should monitor local transport tensions.
Rainwater mixed with sewage in Ambattur Industrial Estate, and the district team should coordinate with local bodies to address drainage contamination issues.
The government helped tribal communities in Pazhaverkadu become entrepreneurs by supporting fish and crab farming, and the office should review expansion plans.
CapitaLand opened its second data centre in Chennai targeting hyperscalers, and the portfolio team should engage with the company on digital infrastructure growth.
Telangana invited Tamil Nadu businesses to join its growth journey and announced a new drone park and policy, and the office should watch competitive tech policies.
CapitaLand India Trust saw new developments affecting its securities trading, and the portfolio team should monitor market updates regarding the trust.
